punchline: A day into the flight to the Moon, Swigert said his tax return was unfiled, and Houston took it up.
thirty_sec: Jack Swigert replaced Ken Mattingly days before the April 1970 launch; about 24 hours into Apollo 13 he told the ground he had not filed his income tax, and Capcom Joe Kerwin relayed that Tom Stafford would get him an extension.
question: Which loose end of yours is the team not yet aware of, and who could take it off you if you named it today?
key_contrast: Saying the loose end aloud, not carrying it alone.
